version:3.1.0

API name: get nodes list
Parameter_fabricName:PEK-ACI

function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends an HTTP GET request to retrieve a list of nodes associated with a specified fabric in a network. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to send the GET request to. The URL should include the target IP, API endpoint, and the fabricName query parameter placeholder https://<ip>/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/nodes?fabricName={fabricName}.

fabricName.description: The name of the fabric whose nodes are to be listed. This value is used to replace the {fabricName} placeholder in the URL.

The function expects url and fabricName. The default URL is "https://<ip>/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/nodes?fabricName={fabricName}". We need to replace <ip> with 192.168.11.33 and fabricName with PEK-ACI.

Thus the URL: https://192.168.11.33/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/nodes?fabricName=PEK-ACI

We can call the function. Then we can explain how to generate the request manually or via cURL. Provide example cURL command: curl -k -X GET "https://192.168.11.33/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/nodes?fabricName=PEK-ACI" -H "Accept: application/json" -u username:password

Also mention authentication, maybe token. Provide steps: open Nexus Dashboard, navigate to API section, choose GET nodes list, set fabricName param, click Generate Request, copy cURL.
